trap.label: subjuntivo base
trap.wrong: He insisted that the court was open.
trap.right: He insisted that the court be open.
trap.why: O português tem subjuntivo marcado (“que esteja”). Em inglês, após insist/demand/recommend o verbo fica na forma base, sem -s nem was.

mcq.q: He insisted that the court ___ open.
The doctor recommended that she ___ rest.
It is essential that he ___ on time.

fix.wrong: She suggested that he comes early.
fix.right: She suggested that he come early.

fix.wrong: I demand that she is present.
fix.right: I demand that she be present.

fix.wrong: It is vital that the file is sent.
fix.right: It is vital that the file be sent.

rewrite.prompt: Subj.: “The judge insists that the room is open.”
rewrite.answer: The judge insists that the room be open.

rewrite.prompt: Subj.: “I recommend that she takes a break.”
rewrite.answer: I recommend that she take a break.

rewrite.prompt: Subj.: “It is essential that the form is signed.”
rewrite.answer: It is essential that the form be signed.
